prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: precise edit of an existing responsive event card image for an illustrative pre-launch program
Primary request: Remove every readable table number, QR code, and identifier from the existing Klang business matchmaking scene. Replace the foreground placard showing “8”, the midground placard showing “3”, and the two QR-style desk signs in the back-left check-in area with clean, unmarked frosted acrylic or softly lit neutral markers. Preserve the people, faces, body positions, tables, venue, camera framing, depth of field, lighting, blue evening atmosphere, and all other composition details as closely as possible.
Composition/framing: keep the source image’s wide landscape 3:2 composition and edge-safe center crop unchanged
Constraints: no numbers, letters, QR patterns, logos, flags, readable signage, text, or watermark anywhere in the final image; do not change the people or turn the scene into a different event
